mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.category_id, s.contact_phone, s.address, s.open_time, s.close_time, s.view_count, s.status, s.is_recommend, s.logo_url, s.image_url, s.introduction, s.sort, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.create_time, sc.category_name FROM store s LEFT JOIN store_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.category_id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId}
